PORTFOLIO CUSTOMIZATION
========================

1. Replace placeholder contact details in src/main.jsx:
   - your.email@example.com
   - linkedin.com/in/your-profile
   - github.com/yourusername

2. Add your resume:
   - Put your PDF inside public/
   - Rename it to: resume.pdf

3. Replace education/certification placeholders.

4. Update project descriptions and links.

5. Run:
   npm install
   npm run dev

6. Build for production:
   npm run build
